summary: When the periodic re-check finds an organization's verified domain has lost its DNS TXT record, Polar now emails every org member who can manage the organization ('<domain> is no longer verified'), with the TXT record to re-add, a link to domain settings, and a note that members on that domain are no longer sent straight to SSO.

statements.why: New notification email to org admins only (filtered by organization_manage permission in service.py); the TXT value it includes is the org's own verification token shown in their settings.

statements.text: Most of this change is in a new file, server/emails/src/emails/domain_verification_lost.tsx (60 lines added).
statements.why: New email template; 60 non-blank lines (63 total). Doesn't say it's an email.

statements.text: The agent also changed server/polar/email/schemas.py and server/polar/organization_domain/service.py, in ways plain can't describe yet.
statements.why: True but uninformative; service.py is where the email gets sent.

misses.what: New email: organization admins are now emailed when one of their verified domains loses its DNS verification, with instructions to re-add the TXT record; until fixed, members on that domain are no longer routed straight to SSO sign-in.
